headline: Former BOJ Official Expects Rate Hike in December and 2% Terminal Rate
summary: A former top central bank economist stated that the Bank of Japan is likely to raise interest rates in December and target a terminal rate of 2%.
why: Shifts in the Bank of Japan's monetary policy path influence global carry trades, Japanese government bond yields, and the valuation of the yen against major currencies.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Expectations of central bank interest rate hikes typically support domestic yields and currency values.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Comments pointing toward imminent policy tightening by the Bank of Japan reinforce expectations of higher borrowing costs.
